question: According to the UN department of economic and social affairs data, _________ had the largest diaspora in the world by end of 2020.
solution:
The correct answer is __**India.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Indian Diaspora**

 
 
• As per **International Organisation for Migration’s** (IOM) latest report,** Global Migration Report 2020**, India continues to be the largest country of origin of international migrants with a 17.5 million-strong diaspora across the world.
 
• The top three countries of origin of international migrants – are **India (17.5 million) > Mexico (11.8 million) > China (10.7 million).**
 
• Between the years 2000 and 2020, the migrant population living overseas grew in nearly all areas and countries worldwide.
 
• As per the UN Report, “India experienced the largest gain during that period nearly 10 million
 
• According to the UN’s International Migration 2020 Highlights, **India’s diaspora, the largest in the world, is distributed across a number of major countries of destination.**
